articles.title: GitHub Copilot's Project HydraFusion Promises Frontier Level Performance Through Multi-Model Routing
articles.author: Olimpiu Pop
articles.summary: GitHub's Project HydraFusion is a research preview for GitHub Copilot that enhances coding intelligence through runtime model orchestration. It dynamically assembles execution plans using models from various providers. The system employs three execution patterns based on task complexity. Evaluations indicate that it achieves high task quality while significantly reducing operational costs. By Olimpiu Pop
